name: ZX_DET_FACTOR_TEMPL_B
description: This table stores the sets of determining factors. Each record represents one determining factor set.

columns.name: DET_FACTOR_TEMPL_CODE
columns.description: Determining factor template code

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code

columns.name: TEMPLATE_USAGE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate usage of the determining factor template. Possible values are TAXABLE_BASIS, TAX_REGIME_DETERMINATION and TAX_RULES

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_LOGIN_ID
columns.description: Login user identifier of this record by a concurrent program

columns.name: DET_FACTOR_TEMPL_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger defining column

columns.name: CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
columns.description: Accounting key flexfield structure defining column

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Program name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Application name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax code for which template has been defined.

columns.name: SERVICE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Rule type for which template has been defined.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
